rec.name: Testimonial Videos Slider
rec.status: Built — launched (documented, added to product catalog)

what.text: A standalone, theme-editor-configurable Shopify section that shows a horizontally scrollable slider of vertical customer testimonial videos. On desktop, a left column holds the headline, sub-headline and text CTA link with an arrow. To its right sit the video cards, each with a custom thumbnail and a translucent play-button overlay. A round badge such as '300,000+ customers love [Brand]' overlaps the top-left or top-right corner of the video area. The editor supports up to 15 video blocks.

why.text: Short, authentic UGC videos from real customers are strong social proof. They show the product in real hands and real settings, which lowers perceived risk for new visitors. The large-number badge adds a bandwagon cue ('300,000+ customers love us') right next to the proof. A thumbnail with a play button invites a low-effort click. The optional CTA below the headline channels the trust into the next step.

how.text: Build a custom Shopify section (Liquid, schema, CSS, JS) with global section settings and a repeatable 'Video' block. Each block has a direct video URL (an MP4 uploaded to Shopify Files, not YouTube/Vimeo) and an image_picker thumbnail used as the video poster. Videos render as native <video> tags with the poster. An SVG play button overlays each video and hides while the video plays. Native controls show only during playback. Clicking a video toggles play/pause. The slider uses Slick Carousel with variableWidth, no arrows or dots, and infinite off. Slick and jQuery must be loaded in theme.liquid. Slide widths are fixed (about 224px on mobile, 284px on desktop). From 1000px up, the header becomes a fixed-width (295px) left column beside the slider. Add a small script so only one video plays at a time and the others pause. Re-initialise the slider on the shopify:section:load event. Editors should click Save in the theme editor to re-initialise the slider.

items: Border style: rounded or square corners
Video blocks (up to 15): video URL + thumbnail image

dependencies.text: jQuery and Slick Carousel (CDN) must be added to theme.liquid. The section does not include them. Videos must be uploaded to Shopify Files or another direct MP4 source, because YouTube links will not work. Thumbnails are chosen via image_picker. If the same Shopify file is reused across slides, editing it changes every slide that references it. No product metafields are needed (the ticket marks the metafield question as 'MF/N'). A container class and theme CSS variables for fonts are assumed. Whether non-developers can set it up is still to be clarified.

items: Conversion rate and revenue per session for visitors who viewed or played a video

images.caption: Desktop final design: left column with italic headline, sub-headline and underlined 'Jetzt mehr erfahren →' CTA; three vertical testimonial videos with centered play buttons; dark round badge '300.000+ Kund:innen lieben Doonails' overlapping the top-left corner.
Theme editor sidebar: the 'Testimonial Videos' section with a list of repeatable Video blocks, each with a thumbnail, and an 'add video' control.
Mobile view: headline, sub-headline and CTA on top, round badge overlapping the right edge, and horizontally swipeable video cards with play buttons.
Documentation screenshot of the Video block fields: 'Video url' (paste the link to the testimonial video) and 'Video thumbnail' (image shown before play).
Early test build in the editor showing the badge, a placeholder video, and the 'No image' state when a thumbnail is missing; shows the stacked layout bug fixed before launch.
